paper.title: Federation over Harness
paper.abstract: Modern LLM-powered agents increasingly improve through experience sharing, where distributed agents distill local reasoning experience into reusable knowledge, such as a shared insight library. Existing approaches, however, still heavily rely on manually designed prompts and workflows that determine both how local agents extract useful reasoning traces and how a central/global agent aggregates them to obtain common patterns and insights. We propose Federation over Harness (FoH), a framework that automatically evolves the harness for both local and global components in this distributed multi-agent reasoning pipeline. A server agent evolves the client harness for task solving and self-reflection while, at the same time, evolving its own harness for aggregating distributed reflections, maintaining shared knowledge, and updating subsequent client harnesses. Importantly, FoH requires no extra validation signals, such as ground-truth labels or validation data, during evolution; it learns solely from self-generated reflections produced by distributed agents. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that FoH consistently improves over single-agent baselines with a fixed harness and with harness self-evolution by 53.57% and 29.76%.

one_sentence.text: FoH 针对经验共享智能体依赖人工提示与工作流的问题，以客户端反思驱动服务器和客户端 harness 共同演化；作者报告相对固定 harness 单智能体及 harness 自演化基线分别提升 53.57% 和 29.76%。

evidence.quote: To this end, we propose Federation over Harness (FoH) , a framework for federated harness evolution driven solely by agent-generated reflections.

FoH outperforms the SOTA single-agent harness by 53.57%, non-federated harness evolution by 29.76%, and fixed-harness federated self-evolution by 22.38%, while reducing task-completion tokens by 34.09%.

research_problem.text: 研究问题是如何在不使用外部任务表现监督的条件下，让联邦智能体的经验共享流程及演化策略本身持续更新；人类通过文本指南限定搜索空间。

evidence.quote: We propose Federation over Harness (FoH) , advancing federated agents in two directions: enabling self-evolution without external validation and making the evolution strategy itself evolvable, with humans defining the search space through lightweight textual guides.

research_problem.text: 按本文描述，RHO 的演化算法及 rollout、重求解次数预先固定，FoT 仅更新洞见库；作者希望扩大可演化范围。这些前作描述未经前作全文独立核验。

evidence.quote: However, RHO focuses on single-agent settings, and employs a fixed, manually designed evolution algorithm with predefined numbers of task rollouts and re-solving iterations where its evolution algorithm remains unchanged throughout optimization.

We also include FoT [ 22 ] , in which clients upload reflections and the server aggregates them into an insight library without evolving prompts or other harness components, i.e., only the insight library evolves.

method_steps.text: 用文本指南限定 harness 搜索空间，将其表示为可执行代码仓库；客户端同步最新仓库。初始服务器使用 Hermes Agent 与 ReAct。

evidence.quote: Humans provide only a lightweight, plaintext guide describing the allowable harness search space and expected behavior.
We represent each harness as a repository containing the code required for execution. Clients obtain updated harnesses through repository synchronization (e.g., Git pull).
The initial server harness \mathcal{H}_{s}^{(0)} is instantiated as a Hermes Agent [ 11 ] using ReAct [ 23 ] .

method_steps.text: 客户端结合用户资源独立完成任务，将答案返回用户，仅向服务器上传反思；反思依据本地任务、响应和轨迹生成，不接触标准答案、奖励或留出验证样例。

evidence.quote: Each client receives the latest shared harness \mathcal{H}_{c} , integrates user-provided resources (tools, environments, file systems, and chat history), and returns the response to the user, uploading only R_{i} to the server
The reflection has access only to the local task, response, and trajectory, with no ground-truth answer, reward, or held-out validation example.

method_steps.text: 服务器先依据反思及当前两侧 harness 更新自身，再用更新后的服务器生成下一版客户端 harness；服务器维护共享洞见库，供客户端作为外部知识使用。

evidence.quote: First, it runs under \mathcal{H}_{s}^{(t)} to produce \mathcal{H}_{s}^{(t+1)} , using the server guide, the collected reflections, and the current server and client harnesses.
Second, it runs under the updated server harness \mathcal{H}_{s}^{(t+1)} to produce \mathcal{H}_{c}^{(t+1)} , using the client guide, the same reflections, and the current client harness.
The shared insight library is updated on the server side, evolves jointly with other components of the server harness, and is used on the client side as external knowledge.

author_contributions.text: 作者自述贡献是无需外部验证的联邦 harness 演化，以及让演化策略本身可演化；提供材料不足以独立确认创新优先权。

evidence.quote: We propose Federation over Harness (FoH) , advancing federated agents in two directions: enabling self-evolution without external validation and making the evolution strategy itself evolvable, with humans defining the search space through lightweight textual guides.

author_contributions.text: 作者汇总报告：相对其称为 SOTA 的单智能体 harness、非联邦 harness 演化和固定 harness 联邦自演化，提升分别为 53.57%、29.76%、22.38%；任务完成 token 减少 34.09%，服务器演化额外提升 4.50%。

evidence.quote: FoH outperforms the SOTA single-agent harness by 53.57%, non-federated harness evolution by 29.76%, and fixed-harness federated self-evolution by 22.38%, while reducing task-completion tokens by 34.09%. Evolving the server harness further improves performance by 4.50% over a fixed server harness

reported_comparisons.text: 本文将 RHO 描述为每个 harness 需要 10 次客户端 rollout、提出 3 个候选后舍弃 2 个；FoH 利用多客户端反思，每轮生成一个更新版本。该描述尚未通过前作独立核验。

evidence.quote: each harness requires 10 client-agent rollouts, after which the aggregation agent proposes three new harnesses and discards the two unselected ones.

FoH instead exploits the federated setting itself: multiple client agents naturally provide reflections on the shared harness, so the server generates only one updated harness per iteration and wastes no computation on discarded candidates.

reported_comparisons.text: 实验各方法使用相同 LLM 和指南定义的搜索空间；RHO 保留预设优化流程，但被置于相同联邦客户端/服务器环境。因此汇总中的“非联邦”措辞不能直接理解为实际实验部署。

evidence.quote: All methods use the same LLM and harness search space defined by identical guides.
for RHO, we retain its predefined optimization procedure while placing it in the same federated client/server setting.

reported_comparisons.text: 比较范围未包括需要外部验证的方法；作者理由是公平比较需构建覆盖任务域及执行环境的代表性验证集，偏置验证集可能使比较不可靠。

evidence.quote: Methods requiring external validation are not considered in this work because a fair comparison would require constructing a representative validation set covering diverse task domains and execution environments, including system kernels, containers, and tools.
If the validation set is biased toward particular tasks or environments, the comparison may yield unreliable results.

experiments.text: 日常任务实验仅用 PinchBench V1 的 23 个任务驱动演化，在新增的 124 个 V2 任务及 ClawEval 上评估迁移；FoH 三组得分均高于表中 ReAct、FoT 和 RHO。

evidence.quote: We use the 23 tasks in PinchBench [ 6 ] V1 as existing tasks and the 124 tasks subsequently added in V2 as held-out tasks. Only the 23 V1 tasks are used to generate client reflections and evolve the harness; the held-out PinchBench tasks and ClawEval [ 24 ] are used solely for evaluation.

Token columns report output tokens; the maximum per LLM call is 16,384 (client) and 32,768 (server), with at most 30 LLM calls per task and no runtime limit. We run 15 iterations; isolated-agent performance is the best of 15 independent runs.
Base LLM: DeepSeek-V4-Flash; judge: GPT-Luna-5.6-Pro (High). Sandbox: CPUs, 64 GB memory, Python 3.10, and Conda; other settings follow benchmark defaults.

Furthermore, for each application, we run FoH two more independent times. The average accuracies (with 95% confidence intervals) on Application 1 ( Section 4.2 ) for existing, held-out, and new tasks are 93.96% \pm 2.58%, 92.53% \pm 1.63%, and 78.32% \pm 0.43%, respectively.

experiments.task: PinchBench V1 既有任务、V2 新增留出任务、ClawEval。
experiments.baseline: 孤立 ReAct、FoT、置于联邦环境的 RHO。
experiments.metric: 表 1 任务得分；总输出 token／任务完成输出 token；附录报告准确率及 95% 置信区间。
experiments.resource_conditions: 演化 15 轮；孤立智能体取 15 次独立运行最佳值。客户端／服务器单次调用输出上限 16,384／32,768 token；每任务最多 30 次调用，无运行时限。CPU、64 GB 内存、Python 3.10、Conda。附录称每个应用追加两次独立 FoH 运行。

experiments.text: ScienceAgentBench 在各领域内等分既有集与留出集。FoH 留出集 SR 为 58.8%，高于各基线；移除洞见库、本地反思或工具演化后，SR 明显降低。

evidence.quote: We split the benchmark into two equal halves of existing and held-out tasks, taking half of the tasks from each domain for each split, and measure the valid execution rate (VER) and success rate (SR) using the benchmark’s standardized criteria
We use Claude Opus-5.5 (High), run evolution for 5 iterations, and do not limit the number of LLM calls; other settings follow Table 1 .

experiments.task: ScienceAgentBench；每个领域各取一半任务组成既有集和留出集。
experiments.baseline: 孤立 ReAct、FoT、联邦环境中的 RHO；固定服务器、无洞见库、无本地反思、无工具演化的 FoH。
experiments.metric: 有效执行率 VER、成功率 SR；总输出 token／任务完成输出 token。
experiments.result: FoH 既有集 VER／SR 为 84.3／51.0，留出集为 88.2／58.8。ReAct、FoT、RHO 的留出集 VER／SR 分别为 78.4／11.8、88.2／21.6、76.5／31.4。固定服务器、无洞见库、无本地反思、无工具演化的留出集 SR 为 52.9、19.6、15.7、19.6。FoH 总输出／任务完成输出为 2.55M／1.27M，ReAct 为 1.91M／1.91M。
experiments.resource_conditions: 演化 5 轮，不限制 LLM 调用次数；其余设置沿用表 1。

experiments.text: 隐私补充实验比较原始轨迹、FoH 反思及反思加客户端仓库：后两者未检出所测敏感项，输入重建指标也较低；作者明确不将其视为全面隐私保护证明。

evidence.quote: Using execution traces from Application 1 ( Section 4.2 ), we compare three information-sharing settings: (1) raw execution trajectories, (2) client-uploaded reflections in FoH, and (3) reflections together with the evolved client harness code repository.

Regular-expression matching identifies 10 secrets, 310 identity information entries, and 68 paths in raw trajectories, compared with zero detected instances in reflections alone and reflections combined with harness code.
The LLM-based pipeline identifies an additional 3 secrets, 16 identity information entries, and 12 paths in raw trajectories, while detecting no instances in either FoH sharing setting.
The attacker uses Fable 5.1 (High) with PinchBench V1 reasoning traces in FoH to reconstruct the original input.
The attacker employs multiple agents that interact over three rounds to progressively refine their reconstruction.
Context Source Char. Similarity Token F1 BLEU-4 Raw Trajectories 54.7% 60.2% 20.4 FoH Reflections 41.2% 33.6% 4.6 FoH Reflections + Client Harness Repo 45.7% 36.1% 9.9
Although the server agent can develop harness mechanisms related to privacy and malicious reflections, we do not present them as proof of comprehensive privacy protection.

experiments.task: 应用 1 轨迹的敏感信息检测及 PinchBench V1 原始输入重建。
experiments.model: 输入重建攻击模型为 Fable 5.1 (High)；敏感信息检测所用 LLM 未在提供摘录中明确。
experiments.baseline: 原始执行轨迹，对比仅共享 FoH 反思及反思加客户端 harness 仓库。
experiments.metric: 秘密、身份信息、路径检出数；字符相似度、token F1、BLEU-4。
experiments.result: 正则在原始轨迹检出 10／310／68 条秘密／身份信息／路径，LLM 额外检出 3／16／12 条；两种 FoH 共享设置均为零检出。按原始轨迹／反思／反思加仓库顺序，字符相似度为 54.7%／41.2%／45.7%，token F1 为 60.2%／33.6%／36.1%，BLEU-4 为 20.4／4.6／9.9。
experiments.resource_conditions: 输入重建由多个攻击智能体交互 3 轮；总 token、攻击智能体数量和运行成本未在提供摘录中明确。

limitations.text: 作者明确承认：移除验证数据后，没有显式信号保证每次服务器更新都会改善 harness；图 5 描述还指出，指南排除洞见库或本地反思时会出现不稳定。

evidence.quote: Removing validation data introduces one limitation: no explicit signal guarantees that each server update yields a better harness; however, we empirically show that our guide design helps the server find better harnesses.
Figure 5: Performance on PinchBench V1. With properly configured guides, FoH steadily improves and converges, but becomes unstable when the guide excludes the insight library or local reflection.

limitations.text: 当前框架假设同步聚合与拉取。异步和个性化属于扩展方向；作者指出数千异构客户端的源 harness 拼接可能超出上下文窗口，压缩、选择或分层聚合仍待研究。

evidence.quote: Our current framework assumes synchronous aggregation and harness pulling, which suggests two extensions.

With thousands of heterogeneous clients, however, concatenating all source harnesses may exceed the context window, particularly if clients further personalize their harnesses; compression, selection, or hierarchical aggregation for such settings is an interesting future direction.

limitations.text: 作者未将补充实验视为全面隐私保护证明，系统隐私评估及恶意反思留待未来；自主演化可能偏离人类控制、绕过安全约束或产生有害内容，是作者讨论的风险而非已报告的实验发现。

evidence.quote: Comprehensive privacy assessment, malicious reflections, and related aspects are deferred to future work, as our current guide design is optimized for task performance rather than these directions

Because FoH is a fully autonomous framework in which agents can self-evolve, including the server-agent harness, the evolution process may drift beyond intended human control and potentially develop behaviors that bypass safety constraints or generate harmful content.

roles.text: 一个中央服务器协调 N 个客户端；客户端使用共享 harness 独立解决不同但相关的用户任务。

evidence.quote: FoH consists of a central server agent \mathcal{A}_{s} and N client agents \mathcal{A}_{c_{1}},\ldots,\mathcal{A}_{c_{N}} . Clients independently solve different but related user tasks using a shared client harness \mathcal{H}_{c}

coordination.text: 服务器集中汇集反思，先更新自身 harness，再生成共享客户端 harness；协作主要通过跨任务经验聚合实现。

evidence.quote: First, it runs under \mathcal{H}_{s}^{(t)} to produce \mathcal{H}_{s}^{(t+1)} , using the server guide, the collected reflections, and the current server and client harnesses.
Second, it runs under the updated server harness \mathcal{H}_{s}^{(t+1)} to produce \mathcal{H}_{c}^{(t+1)} , using the client guide, the same reflections, and the current client harness.

communication.text: 上行仅上传客户端反思，答案返回用户；下行通过仓库同步获取更新后的 harness。

evidence.quote: Each client receives the latest shared harness \mathcal{H}_{c} , integrates user-provided resources (tools, environments, file systems, and chat history), and returns the response to the user, uploading only R_{i} to the server
Clients obtain updated harnesses through repository synchronization (e.g., Git pull).

shared_memory.text: 共享洞见库由服务器更新，并与服务器其他 harness 组件共同演化；客户端将其作为外部知识使用。

evidence.quote: The shared insight library is updated on the server side, evolves jointly with other components of the server harness, and is used on the client side as external knowledge.

scheduling.text: 当前实现采用同步聚合和同步拉取；异步情形可能收到由陈旧客户端版本产生的反思，尚作为扩展讨论。

evidence.quote: Our current framework assumes synchronous aggregation and harness pulling, which suggests two extensions. In asynchronous FoH, clients finish at different times, so the server may receive reflections generated under stale client harness versions.

changed_object.text: 演化对象覆盖洞见库、提示层和工具层，以及反思轮数、候选生成评估选择等策略；任务描述、权限、历史及用户资源保持固定输入。

evidence.quote: Harness \mathcal{H} consists of three categories: an insight library , prompt-level components , and tool-level components .
FoH lets the evolving harnesses determine these choices, including how many rounds of client reflection to perform and how the server generates, evaluates, and selects new harnesses.
In contrast, task descriptions, access permissions, conversation histories, and other user-owned resources remain fixed inputs from users.

feedback.text: 反馈为智能体依据本地任务、响应和轨迹生成的反思；无外部任务表现监督，但允许执行代码查错等 harness 内部运行检查。

evidence.quote: The reflection has access only to the local task, response, and trajectory, with no ground-truth answer, reward, or held-out validation example.
Validation-free means that the whole system evolves without external task-performance supervision, but permits runtime checks within the harness, such as executing generated code to detect errors.

update_method.text: 服务器以指南、反思及现有 harness 为输入，自更新后再更新客户端；作者报告每轮只生成一个更新版本，无需淘汰候选。

evidence.quote: First, it runs under \mathcal{H}_{s}^{(t)} to produce \mathcal{H}_{s}^{(t+1)} , using the server guide, the collected reflections, and the current server and client harnesses.
Second, it runs under the updated server harness \mathcal{H}_{s}^{(t+1)} to produce \mathcal{H}_{c}^{(t+1)} , using the client guide, the same reflections, and the current client harness.
the server generates only one updated harness per iteration and wastes no computation on discarded candidates.

stage.text: 更新发生在客户端完成任务并产生反思后的轮间阶段；实验运行固定轮数，使用最后一轮 harness 在既有及留出任务上评估。

evidence.quote: Since the evolution is validation-free, we evolve every method for a fixed number of iterations and report performance on existing and held-out tasks using the final-iteration harness.

retention.text: 共享知识及 harness 跨轮保留，并用于跨任务迁移，而非仅限单次任务内修订；跨独立运行的持久化未在提供材料中交代。

evidence.quote: the server develops mechanisms for dropping duplicates (v0), deduplication (v1), and merging insight libraries from previous iterations (v1).
Only the 23 V1 tasks are used to generate client reflections and evolve the harness; the held-out PinchBench tasks and ClawEval [ 24 ] are used solely for evaluation.

held_out_validation.text: 留出任务仅用于事后评估，不参与演化反馈；智能体演化时无法访问基准评估结果。因而“无验证”不表示没有留出集评估。

evidence.quote: Benchmark evaluation results are inaccessible to the agents during evolution.
Only the 23 V1 tasks are used to generate client reflections and evolve the harness; the held-out PinchBench tasks and ClawEval [ 24 ] are used solely for evaluation.

system_insights: 系统分析：应分别解释任务完成成本与完整系统成本。表 2 中 FoH 的任务完成输出低于 ReAct，但总输出更高（b00026）；不能把局部 token 节省直接等同于端到端成本下降。
系统分析：相同 LLM 和搜索空间不等于相同总预算。实际 RHO 采用联邦部署（b00021），因此现有比较无法单独隔离多智能体结构、更新规则和计算量各自的贡献。
系统分析：无外部验证时，指南和反思质量可能成为主要控制因素；原文关于指南删减后不稳定的观察（b00039）支持进一步研究这一依赖，但不足以给出收敛保证。
open_questions: 系统分析问题：在严格匹配总输入输出 token、调用次数及延迟后，FoH 相对单智能体演化的收益还能保留多少？
系统分析问题：能否在不引入任务标签的前提下，可靠检测并回滚有害 harness 更新，而不只是依赖当前指南？
系统分析问题：面对异步陈旧反思、客户端个性化及恶意反思，跨任务收益和隐私表现能否保持？
missing_information: 提供笔记虽标记为 full_text，但没有完整客户端／服务器指南、初始提示词及演化代码，无法重建具体搜索边界和更新实现。
提供材料未明确实验客户端数量、任务分配方式及具体通信频率；当前同步假设已明确，异步与个性化属于扩展讨论。
提供材料未明确表 1 得分的详细计算标准、ScienceAgentBench 任务总数、VER／SR 判定细则，以及 token 统计的完整覆盖范围。
作者汇总提升百分比的计算公式及跨基准聚合口径在提供材料中未明确。
附录已报告每个应用追加两次独立 FoH 运行；但随机种子、置信区间计算方法、均值纳入哪些运行及应用 2 重复运行的具体数值在提供摘录中未明确。
提供材料不足以确认严格等预算的单智能体比较，故相应字段为 null。
跨独立运行持久化、更新失败回滚机制、组件消融对应的完整基准及图 3—5 完整数据未在提供材料中明确。
隐私检测 LLM、完整攻击模板、攻击智能体数量、总预算及统计不确定性未在提供材料中明确。
未提供被引用前作全文，无法独立核验相关工作描述或确认创新优先权；本次仅合成原文笔记，未执行实验。
analysis.priority_reason: 系统判断：该文同时涉及多智能体经验共享、服务器与客户端共同演化及无外部监督更新，并提供留出评估和消融，适合深入阅读；重点审查预算公平性、指南依赖与更新稳定性。

FoH outperforms the SOTA single-agent harness by 53.57%, non-federated harness evolution by 29.76%, and fixed-harness federated self-evolution by 22.38%, while reducing task-completion tokens by 34.09%.

However, RHO focuses on single-agent settings, and employs a fixed, manually designed evolution algorithm with predefined numbers of task rollouts and re-solving iterations where its evolution algorithm remains unchanged throughout optimization.

We also include FoT [ 22 ] , in which clients upload reflections and the server aggregates them into an insight library without evolving prompts or other harness components, i.e., only the insight library evolves.

FoH outperforms the SOTA single-agent harness by 53.57%, non-federated harness evolution by 29.76%, and fixed-harness federated self-evolution by 22.38%, while reducing task-completion tokens by 34.09%. Evolving the server harness further improves performance by 4.50% over a fixed server harness
